answer_1.quote: End-to-end dialogue system directly reads and outputs the utterances in natural language form ... we sample multiple system utterances from the base model and select the best one using the inferred graph.

answer_2.quote: We follow the standard evaluation metric using the official code, which computes three metrics on the MultiWOZ test set: BLEU (average BLEU scores between generated and ground truth response), Info (percentage of dialogs where the system presents an appropriate entity), Succ (percentage of dialogs where the task goals are achieved), and the combined score is computed as Score = BLEU + (Info + Succ)/2.
